Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
a) Can Arishat (and other similar effects) cancel a vampires ballots, just as she could a vampire votes?
b) Where do I find the answer to this question in the rulebook?

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Cardtext :
>
> Independent: Arishat has 1 vote (titled). Once each referendum, she may burn 1 blood to force a vampire to abstain. Infernal.
>
No mention of vote or ballot, it only change the way the vampire use thoses.

> A vampire must cast all of his votes and ballots in agreement.
>
That just nail the point that if you abstain (for vote), you also abstain for ballot.

Others cards may behave differently.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Ashur wrote:
> a) Can Arishat (and other similar effects) cancel a vampires ballots, just as she could a vampire votes?
> b) Where do I find the answer to this question in the rulebook?
>
Cardtext gives the answer:

Name: Arishat
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Baali
Group: 6
Capacity: 6
Discipline: DAI OBF PRE
Independent: Arishat has 1 vote (titled). Once each referendum, she may burn 1 blood to force a vampire to abstain. Infernal.

Arishat doesn't cancel votes (or ballots), she forces a vampire to abstain.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Varkku
Messages.Body:
So does she need to use special ability before vampire chooses how to vote? Or can she use ability after other vampire casts vote?

Rulebook says...
Once a vote or a ballot has been cast, however, it cannot be changed.

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body: She can burn blood after vampires cast votes,and that is the point

Messages.Author: Varkku
Messages.Body: Just want to confirm if this is the official ruling.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Arishat can use her special to force the vampire to abstain after that vampire has cast votes and/or ballots.
